name: user-history
description: A user profile beside a clock with a complete return arrow.
useCase: Open the past activity or change history for a named account.
misuse: Use a label to state the specific communication, account or event action.

16.reason: The complete head and visible shoulder share the user-clock layout; the open return arrow identifies past activity.

24.reason: The full profile, return arrow and two hands remain visible without compressing the account symbol.
